Every resource uses explicitly declared capacity units and availability. Required changeovers occupy the immediate pre-start gap. Exact decimal arithmetic; no unit conversion or hidden default durations. Complete means supplied declarations and checks passed, not a certification of plant feasibility. The owning planner retains solver, dispatch and physical authority.
